data.one_liner: A pure Flutter toast library supporting custom styles and widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a toast notification system for Flutter applications. Allows displaying text messages or fully custom widgets as toasts without requiring a BuildContext at the call site.
use_when: You need to show simple temporary feedback messages across the app.
You want to display custom widget overlays as toasts.
You want to trigger toasts from anywhere in your code without passing BuildContext.
avoid_when: You need persistent snackbars with user action buttons (use ScaffoldMessenger instead).
strengths: Does not require passing BuildContext for every toast call.
Fully customizable appearance using custom widgets.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping your root widget (e.g., MaterialApp) with the OKToast widget.
Can throw errors if not integrated correctly with MediaQuery or MaterialApp builders.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp or root widget with OKToast.
